title: Hello Kitty Inspired Strawberry Drink
description: A homemade strawberry and vanilla blended drink inspired by Hello Kitty; not an official Starbucks beverage.
author: Better Sweet Drinks
ingredients: 1 cup of whole milk (substitute with any milk of your choice for dietary needs)
2 scoops of vanilla bean ice cream or 3 tablespoons of vanilla bean powder
2 tablespoons of white sugar (adjust to taste)
1/2 cup of strawberry puree (fresh or pre-made)
Fresh or freeze-dried strawberries for garnish
1 scoop of freeze-dried or fresh dragon fruit pieces
Optional: Pink food coloring for an extra pop of color
instructions:
Prepare:

  1. Prepare the Strawberry Puree (if making fresh): Blend a handful of fresh strawberries until you achieve a smooth puree. If you’d like it sweeter, feel free to add a bit of sugar to taste. Set aside.

Blend the Frappuccino Base:

  1. In a blender, combine the ice, milk, vanilla bean ice cream or powder, and white sugar.
  2. Blend until all ingredients are combined and the mixture is smooth and creamy. If you’d like a more vibrant color, add a small drop of pink food coloring and blend again.

Layer the Drink:

  1. Take your favorite tall glass and drizzle some of the strawberry puree at the bottom.
  2. Pour the blended Frappuccino mixture over the puree, leaving some space at the top for whipped cream.

Add Toppings:

  1. Add a generous dollop of whipped cream to the top of the blended mixture.
  2. Sprinkle your dragon fruit pieces and additional strawberry inclusions or slices on top of the whipped cream.
  3. Final Touches: For that authentic Hello Kitty vibe, find a Hello Kitty-themed straw or cup to serve it in. Alternatively, simply garnish the whipped cream with Hello Kitty-inspired decorations like a bow or mini edible images.
  4. Serve Immediately: Enjoy your delightful Hello Kitty-inspired drink right away!
notes:
• Fresh vs. Freeze-dried: Using freeze-dried strawberries and dragon fruit will give the toppings a fun crunch. However, that also works perfectly if you prefer fresh fruit for a juicier flavor.
  • Dairy Alternatives: If you’re lactose intolerant or vegan, opt for almond, soy, or oat milk and use a non-dairy ice cream alternative.
  • Sugar Control: Adjust the sugar level to your preference; you can even substitute it with honey, agave, or a sugar-free alternative.
  • Presentation: Get creative with the presentation. A clear glass will show off the layers of your drink, and you can even use Hello Kitty stickers or a themed glass to enhance the theme.
